research_semantics.visible_en: Between the woman and baker, one round loaf has only a narrow central fissure exposing a small line of pale crumb. A broad intact strip of lower crust still joins its two sides, and both people support the still-connected loaf above the bakehouse table. The fissure and the unbroken crust bridge are visible together.
